name: HOOD10 Index
description:
Epoch durations will be extended to eight hours, effective from the next epoch onwards.

Distributing 10 different tokens to thousands of holders every three hours is costly. Rather than having the protocol lose a larger portion of each dividend pot to execution costs, we're allowing each epoch to accumulate for longer.

Payouts remain the same. They'll simply be distributed every eight hours instead of every three.

More of the fees go to holders, where they belong.
biography:
Ten Tokens, One Ticker. The Index of @RobinhoodCrypto Chain.
